summary.text: Stephanie Bice is the incumbent Republican U.S. Representative for Oklahoma's 5th District, seeking re-election. A marketing graduate who worked about 20 years in the private sector, she served in the Oklahoma State Senate from 2014 to 2020 before her election to Congress in 2020. She serves on the Appropriations Committee and chairs a Committee on House Administration subcommittee.

paragraphs.text: Describes herself as a fourth-generation Oklahoman; graduated from Putnam City High School.
Earned a bachelor's degree in marketing from Oklahoma State University.

Worked almost 20 years in the private sector in business development, financial oversight and sales; Ballotpedia lists her as vice president of business development of a boutique digital marketing company.

Served in the Oklahoma State Senate from 2014 to 2020, focusing on fiscal responsibility, economic development and job growth; won the Republican primary runoff for the seat in 2014 and was re-elected in 2018.
Elected to the U.S. House in 2020 and chosen by colleagues as president of the 117th Republican freshman class, the first woman in that role.
In the 118th Congress served on the Appropriations, Science, Space, and Technology, and House Administration committees and was Vice Chair of the Republican Main Street Caucus.

In the current Congress serves on the Appropriations Committee, where she is Vice Chair of the Transportation, Housing, and Urban Development Subcommittee, and chairs the Subcommittee on Modernization and Innovation of the Committee on House Administration.
Named to the U.S. Military Academy at West Point Board of Visitors; her official biography says she and her husband Geoffrey have two adult daughters.
